page.text:
# BRANDYN IVERSON FOR ORINDA CITY COUNCIL
“Raising three boys here (15-19 now), I love having the daily connection to so many Orinda families - it makes me appreciate how rich this community is in interesting, accomplished, and involved people, from the multi-generational Orindans to the new arrivals. I want to make sure your priorities are the city’s priorities.”
Brandyn Iverson was in her third term on the Orinda Planning Commission (Chair 2018-2020) when she was elected to City Council in 2022. She is currently serving as Mayor.
During her 7 years on the Orinda Planning Commission (Chair 2018-2020), she had a seat at the table for the groundwork done on the Downtown Plan: studies and surveys, ULI panel, Connect Orinda, EIR scope, and now, making all of that work dovetail with California’s state-imposed standards for adding housing and density as a matter of right. We just did all the State-required upzoning, and you need someone well versed in housing and housing laws to navigate the implementation for Orinda's best interests.
“ Between City Council and Planning Commission, I have heard a lot of the things that concern you the most about your homes and your town face to face. I have over ten years on the public record, and you have seen that I am a fair and thoughtful listener. ”
Brandyn is a JD/MBA who has used her legal training for a career in business as a builder and a problem solver. With 20+ years in commercial real estate and investments, she is experienced with zoning and land use, has managed large-scale budgets with an owner’s eye to detail, and knows that the best projects are a win for the city and the owner.
Orinda is a special place. It’s safe for free-range kids, has real character, is friendly and collegial, and has a community that gives its time and resources to make our school, sports, and civic life some of the best anywhere. As we balance the State’s mandates on housing with our own priorities for downtown, preserving community character comes first.
### Brandyn Iverson has been endorsed by:
- all current members of the City Council
- all members of the City Council for her first election
- members of the Moraga Orinda Fire District
- members of the Orinda Union School District
- and many other current and former elected officials, appointed officials, and prominent citizens
“I have a real sense of mission to make all of our planning decisions such that our buildings, roads, and housing patterns take the shape of a village – a community of people who feel a bond to the place and to each other. It takes work to resist attrition into being just another suburb, and we have something worth preserving here.”
## On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, Vote
for Brandyn Iverson for Orinda City Council.

page.text:
# Endorsements
Brandyn is supported by the current City Council members, Members of OUSD and MOFD, current and former Mayors, Reps at the State and County, as well as a long list of Orinda’s prominent residents.
Join us – click on the button below to add your name!
Endorse Brandyn!
##### Brandyn Iverson has been endorsed by all
current members of the City Council:
Vice Mayor Darlene Gee
Cara Hoxie
Latika Malkani
Janet Riley
##### Elected Official Endorsements - Current and Former
*All Endorsements from elected officials are personal and not endorsements by their office*
Mark DeSaulnier - US Congress, 10th District
Tim Grayson - California State Senator (District 09)
Rebecca Bauer-Kahan - California State Assembly (District 16)
Candace Anderson – Contra Costa County Supervisor (District 2)
Steve Glazer (former State Senator and Orinda Mayor)
Joyce Hawkins (former Orinda Mayor, Citizen of the Year)
Bill Judge (former Mayor, Citizen of the Year)
Nick Kosla (former Orinda Councilmember)
Bobbie Landers (former Orinda Mayor, Citizen of the Year)
Inga Miller (former Orinda Mayor)
Dean Orr (former Orinda Mayor)
Eve Phillips (former Orinda Mayor, current OUSD Board)
Sue Severson (former Orinda Mayor, Citizen of the Year)
Victoria Smith (former Orinda Mayor)
Amy Worth (former Orinda Mayor, Citizen of the Year)
Vinita Anantavat (current OUSD Board)
Edda Collins Coleman (current OUSD Board)
Katie Shogan (current OUSD Board)
Hillary Weiner (current OUSD Board)
John Jex (current MOFD Board)
Craig Jorgens (current MOFD Board)
Mike Roemer (current MOFD Board)
Marguerite Young (EBMUD Board)
Michael McGill (Central Contra Costa County Sanitary District Board)
##### Citizen Supporters
(Each deserving a full bio on their achievements)
Alison Burns (Orinda Historic Society)
Alex Drexel (Orinda Association)
Alex Evans (former MOFD Board)
Pat Rudenbusch (Orinda Books, former OUSD Board member, Citizen of the Year)
## Supporters are Saying …
"Brandyn Iverson is particularly well qualified to serve the community as a member of the Orinda City Council at this moment, as the City completes its first comprehensive plan for downtown. Her professional background in commercial real estate investment and her experience as chair of the Orinda Planning Commission will bring both professional expertise and extensive knowledge of Orinda as the Council sets the path forward toward much needed downtown renewal.”
- Tom Trowbridge, Orinda Vision (quote from 2022 campaign)
"I have had the distinct pleasure of working with Brandyn Iverson over the last three years, and have found her to be eminently qualified, fair and respectful in her interactions with her fellow Planning Commissioners and the public. In Brandyn’s pivotal role as Chair during the development of the Downtown Precise Plan, while balancing the transition from in-person to virtual commission meetings during COVID-19, exemplified her leadership and forward-thinking style.
I whole-heartedly endorse Brandyn as a candidate for Orinda City Council and believe she will represent the interests of our community with the same leadership and vision she has proven during her time with the Orinda Planning Commission."
- Ann Parnigoni, Chair, Orinda Planning Commission (quote from 2022 campaign)
" Over the decades I've known her, Brandyn has proven herself not only supremely capable but supremely personable and caring. She was born for this job.”
Adam Epstein (quote from 2022 campaign)
#### Ready to Endorse Brandyn Iverson for City Council?
Join the above organizations and respected leaders in supporting Brandyn Iverson for City Council by providing your endorsement below!
Unless otherwise indicated in your submission, we will consider your endorsement as permission to use on this website, literature, and newspaper articles.
## On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, Vote
for Brandyn Iverson for Orinda City Council.
